data.title: Happy Holidays: Play for Free and Earn Rewards until January 7!
data.content:
Happy Holidays, Pilots! As part of the festive fun, everyone can experience the full Early Access version of the game until January 7 via MY.GAMES Launcher or the Steam Demo Version, even if they don’t own a Pioneer Pack.

Celebrate the season with good cheer and the following special events:

Holiday Event (December 25–31) 

Spread cheer to all the Robots in your Hangar with these merry rewards, gifted to you by playing matches:

  • 10 Matches: Lighter x2 (Weapons)
  • 20 Matches: Dazzle x1 (Ability)
  • 25 Matches: Zeus x2 (Weapons)

IMPORTANT: Rewards are subject to a progress wipe when Open Beta begins.

Promo Code Presents

Unwrap special gifts this holiday season with promo codes!

  • MTNWFHVK: Grants Trebuchet x1 (Weapon) 
  • 2ERTARQ5: Grants Lancelot Torso x1 (Robot Part) 

Get them while you can, as these promo codes expire on January 31, 2024. Redeem your codes here.

If you decide to take up residence in the Wild Ten, grab a Pioneer Pack to get a host of awesome in-game content along with full Early Access to War Robots: Frontiers via wrfrontiers.com and Steam.

Subscribe to the official War Robots: Frontiers newsletter to get more of the latest news like this straight to your inbox, follow the game on Twitter and Facebook, and join the official Discord server. You can also follow War Robots: Frontiers on Steam to get the latest news.
